title: libre-ai.brique.v1 — one layer of the brick map
description: One file per layer under ecosystem/briques/ (ADR-0064 D2, D3). A brick is a typed unit of the Libre AI vision: what it is, what it depends on, which invariants and decisions bind it, which repositories carry it, and the dated proofs it can show. No status field exists by construction: the status is derived from the proofs by ecosystem/check-briques.ts (ADR-0064 D4), and a typed-in status is refused by name before this schema is applied. Three rules depend on the layer and are enforced by the checker, each under its own name, not by this schema: a produit brick carries a charte and no other layer does; a fabrique brick declares the proof it produces and no other layer does; a brick of the gouvernance layer carries the discover autonomy. A brick outside the gouvernance layer that cites no invariant is counted and named by the checker, not refused.

couche.description: The layer slug, in ASCII: it is also the file name and the directory of the fiches.

decision.description: An ADR by number, or a row of the decision register.

id.description: Layer prefix and a two-digit number. A product brick carries the number of its product: PRD-02 is P02.

role.description: One sentence: what the brick does.

invariants.description: Invariants of docs/decisions/INVARIANTS.md that bind the brick: those it realises or is directly constrained by. Empty when none does; the checker counts and names such bricks outside the gouvernance layer.

depots.description: Carrier repositories, as written in ecosystem/repositories.v1.yaml. Empty when no repository carries the brick yet.

origine.description: Where the brick comes from (I-33, ADR-0056): derived by inspection of a named source, observed on a dated fact, or Libre AI own.

autonomie.description: The ceiling the doctrine already gives an agent on this brick. It grants nothing: it restates I-17 and the rulesets. discover: read, measure and propose, every write waits for an owner decision. modify: write under the gates and merge on green, outside the human-touch surface. govern: also change the rules of the brick; no brick of the gouvernance layer may carry it.

preuve.description: Dated proofs. A target is either a path of this repository, or a pinned citation `<organisation>/<repository>@<40-hex sha>:<path>` of a public carrier repository, which the pinned-citations gate resolves over git.

preuve_produite.description: For the fabrique layer only, and required there: the proof the brick produces (ADR-0064 D1).

charte.description: For the produit layer only, and required there: five lines a reader outside the project can read.

degel.description: The observable fact that moves the brick from decrite to prototypee. Never a delay or an effort.

abandon.description: The observable fact that withdraws the brick. Never a delay or an effort.

jetable.description: A transitional brick: the condition that ends it.

retrait.description: A withdrawn brick: the register decision that withdrew it. The fiche is kept.
